beats.title: Stars Missing Above the Camp
beats.boundaryReason: The party emerges from its short rest and discusses the altered sky and whether to investigate the tower.
dateEvidence: u0002–u0004 and u0040: twilight after a short rest; session YAML anchors April 15.

beats.title: The Grave and the Vision
beats.boundaryReason: Attention turns from time speculation to excavating the camp grave while Wellby contacts the tower.
dateEvidence: u0307 begins a continuous investigation; u0367–u0441 contain no rest or date change.

beats.title: Climbing to the Guarded Sphere
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo climbs to the platform; initial approaches and magical probes encounter a water guardian. This begins an extended hazardous investigation, split before the direct inscription attempt.
dateEvidence: u0457–u0570 follow the camp investigation directly; the ten-minute ritual at u0802–u0803 is not an overnight rest.

beats.title: Reading the Binding Inscription
beats.boundaryReason: The group moves from distant examination to Delwath entering the pool with Oil of Slipperiness and a Mage Hand distraction; the dangerous inspection ends in retreat.
dateEvidence: u0930–u1088 are the next experiment in the same platform investigation.

beats.title: Voices in the Storm
beats.boundaryReason: The party postpones destroying the sphere and pursues communication with the tower while reassessing the sky.
dateEvidence: u1159: roughly an hour has passed during climbing, meditation, and oil application; the stars are clearer, supporting night on the same date.

beats.title: The Eyeless Bust and Stairway
beats.boundaryReason: The party enters the tower, discovers empty settings, and ascends into an apparent sunlit mountain landscape; includes the brief table break.
dateEvidence: u1454–u1507 describe dreamlike mist and apparent daylight without sleep or elapsed days; u1982 and u2153–u2154 later expose the illusion.

beats.title: Trading Stories with the Giant
beats.boundaryReason: An approaching giant prompts concealment and Wellby’s greeting; exchanged stories reveal a mismatched sense of history and year.
dateEvidence: Continuous encounter; the stated year 5031 at u1788–u1796 belongs to the giant’s perspective, not an actual party date change.

beats.title: Eudomes and the Missing Eyes
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby asks about the tower, provoking fragmented memories of Eudomes and the first suspicion that the mountain is unreal.
dateEvidence: u1818 continues the same conversation; u1978–u1982 suggest the party may never have left the tower.

beats.title: Chains Through the Dream
beats.boundaryReason: The party tests its surroundings and guides the giant toward the stairs; chains appear as he realizes his captivity.
dateEvidence: u2013 locates the same converging ley lines; u2095–u2113 state the party’s present year, and u2153 ends the mountain appearance without an elapsed-day cue.

beats.title: Hralgar’s Captivity Revealed
beats.boundaryReason: The mountaintop gives way to the ruined tower, where Hralgar explains his binding and urges a quick search; includes session wrap-up and table discussion.
dateEvidence: u2154 returns the visible scene to the tower; u2159–u2160 describe the broken roof and star-watching space; no overnight rest occurs before the stop at u2333–u2337.
